usage.source_scope: The fixed zero-shot OA-V2 checkpoint, paired relative orientation, predicted symmetry modes, and consensus behavior were used.
usage.project_application: Convert masked owner-group RGB pairs into the canonical sibling slot needed by the frozen downstream referent selector and pose head.
usage.modifications: OA-V2 remained frozen; BlindAssist added only the route-specific mode-consensus and canonical-slot conversion while keeping the downstream candidate set, selector, and pose head fixed.
usage.expected_effect: Reach at least 70/78 cross-view canonical slot agreement and referent top-1 on the fresh house-disjoint cohort without new wrong-target or absence commits.

evaluation.setup: Fresh source-disjoint ProcTHOR validation cohort with 12 houses and 78 positive pairs; one frozen OA-V2 paired-relative final arm; formal test remained unopened.
evaluation.effect: The route obtained 37/78 canonical-slot agreement, 36/78 referent top-1, 29/78 complete pose, and 2/43 wrong-target cases. Absence false commits were 0/78 and permutation consistency was 156/156. An evaluator-only owner-local control still reached 74/78 referent and 55/78 complete pose, localizing the failure to the RGB-orientation-to-canonical-slot evidence path.
evaluation.claim_boundary: This falsifies only the fixed OA-V2 paired-RGB owner-canonical-slot hypothesis on this synthetic, fresh, house-disjoint cohort. It does not refute OA-V2's general orientation capability and does not establish a natural-image, device, product, user-benefit, or safety conclusion.

evidence.summary: The searchable experiment ledger records the route-specific failed terminal and unopened formal test.
Frozen result report with the cohort, metrics, hashes, attribution, claim boundary, and stop condition.

history.change: The frozen paired-relative arm failed the route gates; the cohort was consumed and the route stopped before depth geometry.
Imported the negative route-specific use into the central reserve without reopening the experiment or broadening its claim.
